description:
An agentic IDE that helps you do your best work with features such as specs, steering, and hooks.

Kiro is an agentic IDE that helps you go from prototype to production with spec-driven development. From simple to complex tasks, Kiro works alongside you to turn prompts into detailed specs, then into working code, docs, and tests—so what you build is exactly what you want and ready to share with your team. Kiro's agents help you solve challenging problems and automate tasks like generating documentation and unit tests. With Kiro, you can build beyond prototypes while being in the driver's seat every step of the way.
Markdown Review, What's New Announcements, and Workflow Step Notifications
This release brings Markdown Review to every Kiro IDE user, so you can comment on Markdown files in your workspace and send the comments to Kiro in one batch. It also adds a What's new announcement browser, makes workflow step notifications easier to scan, can generate commit messages before you stage changes, and fixes terminal, workflow, and sign-in issues.
Review Markdown documents
Open a .md file in your workspace in a rendered review panel, comment on exact passages, and send your comments together. The panel stays current as the file changes and adds an outline, Mermaid controls, and horizontal scrolling for wide tables. Open it from the editor title bar, Command Palette, Specs view, or the Review button on supported spec documents. Learn more ->
